sql: SELECT JSONExtractString(more_info,'mode') mode,uniqExact(tuple(openid,event_time,more_info)) starts,uniqExact(openid) users FROM events WHERE appid='wx85d24d5dbf72b423' AND event_type='level_start' AND event_time>='2026-11-16 00:00:00' AND event_time<'2026-11-16 11:00:00' AND openid>='offk55X-l73O7jYqbHpQy84fVsl8' AND openid<'offk55Y-ZR_h5fOAQcG5XGTbbkqQ'  AND hex(SHA256(openid)) NOT IN ('2C111186BF7A563FD38435C153E609C64BDA13230050212ED9E8BCCF2EC96602') GROUP BY mode LIMIT 10000
